capabilities: Search games by title via the IGDB API
Create game notes from metadata using template files or a built-in renderer
Insert game metadata into an existing note
Download cover images and screenshots into the vault
Translate summary fields via DeepL and fetch Steam playtime and achievements
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice. The IGDB API is free only for non-commercial use under the Twitch Developer Service Agreement. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Steam data requires a public Steam profile; no HowLongToBeat service is contacted.
intentEvidence: This project started as a fork of anpigon/obsidian-book-search-plugin and was adapted for IGDB-based game metadata.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch video game metadata from IGDB and turn it into structured notes with frontmatter, images, and playtime stats.

relations.evidence: This project started as a fork of anpigon/obsidian-book-search-plugin and was adapted for IGDB-based game metadata.
Use the Templater plugin for loops, conditions, or any other scripting inside templates.

requires.name: Twitch Client ID and Client Secret
Steam Web API key stored in Obsidian Secret Storage

summary: Searches the IGDB game database and creates Obsidian notes filled with game metadata, cover images, and optional Steam playtime data.
